column4: Having been given the spiritual authority of Christ on the Earth to establish His kingdom we should work with diligence and haste, for Jesus will return!
column5: Since we have been given the spiritual authority of Christ on earth to build His kingdom, we must work diligently and with urgency, for Jesus is coming back!

column4: The return of Christ is an important part of our faith. The study of the return of Christ and the end times is known as **eschatology**. Many books on eschatology have been written, and *most of them disagree with each other*! Specifically, they disagree on interpretations (figurative, literal, symbolic), the order and timings of the events in the scriptures. I'm reminded of the saying by the great Pentecostal evangelist Reinhard Bonke - “I will split hairs in heaven when I am done breaking chains on Earth!”
column5: The return of Christ is an important part of our faith. The study of the return of Christ and the end of the age is called **eschatology**. Many books about eschatology have been written, and they *often disagree*! In particular, they differ in interpretations (e.g., literal, symbolic), the order and timing of events in Scripture. It reminds me of the saying of the great Pentecostal evangelist Reinhard Bonke - “I will sort out the small things in heaven when I’m finished breaking chains on earth!”

column4: As the author, I’m hesitant to dive very deep into this hotly debated topic given that this book is focused primarily on fundamentals of the faith. I will stick largely to the highest-level view of the events depicted in scripture and focus on what matters most - **the** **mission of the Gospel**!

column4: The return of Christ is the culmination of God’s plan and the reason we live and labor with urgency and purpose.
